exams.name: IELTS
exams.description: Available in Academic and General Training forms, with the Speaking assessment conducted as a face-to-face interview. Widely accepted globally.

exams.name: TOEFL iBT
exams.full_name: Test of English as a Foreign Language
exams.description: A computer-based examination testing academic English. Heavily favoured by North American institutions.

exams.name: PTE Academic
exams.description: A fully computer-marked assessment known for the rapid return of results and objective scoring of spoken English.

exams.name: Duolingo English Test
exams.description: An adaptive, home-administered test increasingly accepted as a flexible alternative to traditional centre-based examinations.

exams.name: CAEL
exams.description: Designed specifically for entry to Canadian institutions, evaluating language use in academic contexts.

exams.name: CELPIP
exams.full_name: Canadian English Language Proficiency Index Program
exams.description: For immigration and professional certification in Canada, assessing functional English for everyday situations.

exams.name: GRE
exams.description: Required for many graduate programmes, assessing verbal reasoning, quantitative reasoning, and analytical writing.

exams.name: GMAT
exams.description: The standard assessment for MBA and other postgraduate business programmes, evaluating analytical and problem-solving abilities.

exams.name: dMAT
exams.description: Specialised assessment preparation tailored for German university entrance requirements for Master's programmes.

exams.name: SAT
exams.description: A multiple-choice test used widely for undergraduate admissions in the United States and other countries.

exams.name: ACT
exams.description: An alternative to the SAT, covering English, mathematics, reading, and science, with an optional writing section.

faqs.question: How long does preparation usually take?
faqs.answer: Preparation timelines vary by student and examination, but typically range from 4 to 12 weeks of focused study. After an initial diagnostic, we create a personalised timeline that works backwards from your application deadlines.

faqs.question: Do I need to take both the IELTS and TOEFL?
faqs.answer: No. Most institutions will accept either. We advise taking a diagnostic test to determine which format better suits your strengths. We then help you focus entirely on one examination to maximise your score.

faqs.question: When should I start preparing?
faqs.answer: We recommend beginning preparation at least 3 to 6 months before your application deadlines to allow time for thorough preparation and a retake if necessary.

faqs.question: Are materials provided?
faqs.answer: Yes, all necessary study materials, including proprietary practice tests, diagnostic tools, and comprehensive e-books are included in our preparation programmes.

faqs.question: What is your approach to test preparation?
faqs.answer: Each student begins with an assessment under examination conditions. The result — not a fixed syllabus — determines the course of study. We focus on the specific areas where you need improvement.
